Rural Geauga Canopy Work Since 1982

Chesterland is a Geauga rural-suburban market with real hardwood density — the heritage oaks, mature maples, ash carrying EAB risk, and original-growth pines that make the township look the way it does. Those are exactly the trees Roubic has worked for more than four decades.

The rural context matters here. Larger wooded lots, longer driveways, and mature specimen trees mean the work has to fit the place — owner-supervised jobs, ANSI A300 pruning standards, crane-assist rigging on the big estate trees, and a full owned equipment fleet rather than rented gear or subcontractors.

Chesterland folks want a crew that knows what a mature Geauga hardwood is worth. That's why we still run every job the way we did in 1982 — carefully, and by hand where it counts. {{global.owner_name}} · Owner
